# Stalwart messages whose expected lists we knowingly do not match.
# One per line: <path under testdata/corpus><TAB><reason>.
# TestCorpus_MatchesExpected fails on a listed message that now matches, so
# the list can only shrink.
stalwart/legacy/026.eml	Undeclared 8-bit text: the design ("Charset") reads bytes that are not UTF-8 as Windows-1252; stalwart replaces each with U+FFFD and loses the letters.
stalwart/legacy/052.eml	Undeclared 8-bit text: the design ("Charset") reads bytes that are not UTF-8 as Windows-1252; stalwart replaces each with U+FFFD and loses the letters.
stalwart/regressions/garbage-line-before-fold.eml	No readable field before the blank line: the design ("Header block cannot be read") keeps the whole input as the text/plain body; stalwart skips the lines and keeps only what follows the blank line.
stalwart/regressions/header-name-smuggled-subject.eml	No readable field before the blank line: the design ("Header block cannot be read") keeps the whole input as the text/plain body; stalwart skips the lines and keeps only what follows the blank line.
stalwart/malformed/001.eml	A multipart whose boundary is never found on a delimiter line: the design ("Boundary missing, or never found") makes its body one text/plain leaf; stalwart files it as a multipart attachment or drops it.
stalwart/malformed/002.eml	A multipart whose boundary is never found on a delimiter line: the design ("Boundary missing, or never found") makes its body one text/plain leaf; stalwart files it as a multipart attachment or drops it.
stalwart/regressions/boundary-of-dashes.eml	A multipart whose boundary is never found on a delimiter line: the design ("Boundary missing, or never found") makes its body one text/plain leaf; stalwart files it as a multipart attachment or drops it.
stalwart/regressions/no-delimiter-close-mid-line.eml	A multipart whose boundary is never found on a delimiter line: the design ("Boundary missing, or never found") makes its body one text/plain leaf; stalwart files it as a multipart attachment or drops it.
stalwart/regressions/unopened-multiparts.eml	A multipart whose boundary is never found on a delimiter line: the design ("Boundary missing, or never found") makes its body one text/plain leaf; stalwart files it as a multipart attachment or drops it.
stalwart/regressions/close-delimiter-first.eml	A multipart with a close delimiter and no parts: the design ("Preamble and epilogue") keeps its preamble as its text; stalwart drops it.
stalwart/regressions/close-delimiter-mid-line.eml	A multipart with a close delimiter and no parts: the design ("Preamble and epilogue") keeps its preamble as its text; stalwart drops it.
stalwart/regressions/fallback-delimiter-after-text.eml	A delimiter inside a line: RFC 2046 §5.1.1 and the design ("A boundary splitter") take delimiters only at the start of a line, so the bytes stay content; stalwart's fallback delimiter cuts the part there.
stalwart/regressions/fallback-delimiter-mid-line.eml	A delimiter inside a line: RFC 2046 §5.1.1 and the design ("A boundary splitter") take delimiters only at the start of a line, so the bytes stay content; stalwart's fallback delimiter cuts the part there.
stalwart/thirdparty/005.eml	A delimiter inside a line: RFC 2046 §5.1.1 and the design ("A boundary splitter") take delimiters only at the start of a line, so the bytes stay content; stalwart's fallback delimiter cuts the part there.
stalwart/regressions/alternative-dropped-footer.eml	A part that parseStructure puts in no list: backfill adds it to attachments, because RFC 8621 makes every leaf in neither body list an attachment and the design never drops a part; stalwart's other_parts drops it.
stalwart/regressions/alternative-nested-dropped.eml	A part that parseStructure puts in no list: backfill adds it to attachments, because RFC 8621 makes every leaf in neither body list an attachment and the design never drops a part; stalwart's other_parts drops it.
stalwart/malformed/007.eml	Two Content-Type fields in one part: the header is a go-message textproto.Header (design, "A lenient header parser") and its Get reads the first; stalwart reads the last.

stalwart/malformed/003.eml	Nested multiparts with the same or prefix-related boundaries: delimiters are matched exactly to the outer boundary first (RFC 2046 §5.1.1 forbids an inner boundary that an outer one matches), so inner parts split differently and an epilogue after the outer close is dropped (design, "Preamble and epilogue"); stalwart matches the innermost boundary first.

stalwart/malformed/019.eml	A mangled message whose part headers run into their text: a line that is not a field ends the header and starts the body, and a multipart with no delimiter is one text/plain leaf (design, "Accept liberally"); stalwart reads those lines as headers and keeps the parts empty.
stalwart/malformed/023.eml	Content-Type "multipart" with no subtype: the design ("Missing or unparseable Content-Type") reads the part as text/plain and keeps all its bytes; stalwart reads it as a multipart split at a suffixed delimiter.
stalwart/regressions/header-block-edge-cases.eml	A line that is not a field ends the header and starts the body, so no byte is dropped (design, "Accept liberally"); stalwart skips the line and keeps only what follows the blank line.
